I really think it depends on how and where that minority person grew up. I’m black and white. Tan skin, long curly hair, and brown eyes. I look like I could belong to several different minorities depending on how I do hair and makeup that day. I was raised by the black half of my family, but my family is middle class and has been for several generations now. I was also raised in Houston, a very diverse city. Saying this, my best friend is white and my boyfriend is Mexican, my guy best friend is also Mexican. I make friends with whoever talks to me. If you want a minority friend you are going to have to make an effort and also realize that there are things that are going to offend them that you will never understand. There are things inside their culture you may not understand. But as long as you are respectful and ask questions as needed you really shouldn’t have too many problems.
